title: Fix E2E harness: Vite dev server crashes mid-suite + agent-mcp endpoint not wired
description:
E2E suite grew from 18 to 38 tests. Two new failure categories:

1. DEV SERVER INSTABILITY: After agent-mcp.spec.ts runs (fetches /mcp endpoint), Vite dev server stops accepting connections. All subsequent tests get ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. Fix: ensure the MCP plugin or fetch handler does not crash the server; or add server health check / restart between spec files in playwright.config.ts.

2. AGENT-MCP ENDPOINT: agent-mcp.spec.ts (7 tests) fails with 'TypeError: fetch failed' on /mcp — the MCP WS relay or HTTP endpoint from task 0613 is not yet served by the Vite dev server. Either wire it up or add a conditional skip while the feature is in-progress.

3. INTERACTIVITY cascading failures: interactivity.spec.ts (2/3 tests) fail with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED because the server already crashed from #1. Fix #1 first.

Run: pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e to verify — target 38/38 once both are fixed.
